title: core.semantics — facet tags, style embedding, palette
description: What this entity IS, in terms a search index can use. Law 9 in its purest form: this node is simultaneously the runtime's material/mood hint, the store's filter facets, and the nearest-neighbour index entry — one payload, three masters. The tag vocabulary is the registry in spec/facets.json, which travels in the package.

facets_version.description: The 'version' field of the spec/facets.json this file's tags were drawn from. A reader validating tags MUST use the registry in THIS package, never a newer one it happens to know.

facets.description: One array per facet. Every tag MUST either appear in that facet's canonical list in spec/facets.json, or start with 'x.' (the free-tag escape hatch). Order within an array is significance-descending; the first tag is the one a single-tag UI shows.

tag_stamps.description: Optional per-tag epistemic stamps, keyed 'facet/tag'. A tag with no stamp inherits the node version's stamp from the manifest.

embedding.description: A style/appearance embedding for nearest-neighbour search. Carrying the vector inside the artifact means a store can index a freshly dropped file with no model loaded — but only if it knows which model produced it, hence 'model' is mandatory and vectors from different models are never comparable.

model.description: Exact model identity including revision, e.g. 'openclip-vit-l-14/laion2b-s32b-b82k'. An embedding whose model is unknown is noise.

dtype.description: JSON numbers, read as IEEE-754 binary32. Declared so a reader knows not to expect more precision than it gets.

normalized.description: True when |vec| == 1 within 1e-5, so a consumer can use a dot product as cosine similarity without renormalising.

vec.description: Exactly 'dim' values. A validator MUST check the length against dim; JSON Schema cannot express that cross-field constraint, so it is stated here as a normative reader check.

input.description: What was embedded: which rendered views, or which text.

views.description: Paths of the images that were embedded and averaged.

palette.description: The entity's dominant colours, for filtering, for thumbnail backgrounds, and for a runtime that tints particles or debris to match.

linear_rgb.description: The same colour, linearised, for maths. Both are stored because converting between them is where colour bugs live.

weight.description: Fraction of visible surface. Weights sum to 1.0 within 1e-3 WHEN THE PALETTE COVERS THE WHOLE SURFACE. A deliberately truncated top-N palette sums to less than 1, and MUST say so in `method` rather than renormalising: renormalised weights would disagree with the same palette carried in a core.embedding WKEM payload, and two spellings of one fact that disagree are worse than one spelling. Recorded as spec finding S-24, from the first package to carry both spellings.

dominant_index.description: Index into colors of the single colour that best represents the entity.

average_luminance.description: Linear luminance of the visible surface, useful for choosing a contrasting thumbnail background.

description.description: One paragraph of natural language. Also the search index text (law 9).

keywords.description: Free text search terms outside the facet registry. Not validated, never load-bearing.
